SYNTHETIC DEMO DOCUMENT - NOT A REAL FINANCIAL OR OFFICIAL RECORD
Management accounts, May 2025 to Oct 2026
Nixo Inc. | Period: May 2025 to Oct 2026 | Version 1.0 | Issued 16 Nov 2026
Basis of preparation
Prepared by the company with its outsourced accountant; unaudited. Accrual basis. Amounts in USD, whole units. Revenue recognition: platform subscriptions at 1,200 per forward-deployed engineering seat per month are invoiced monthly in advance and recognised in the month of service. Onboarding and integration fees are invoiced at contract signature and recognised in thirds over the first three months from go-live. Hosting, model inference and the contract forward-deployed engineers who deliver onboarding are reported in cost of revenue.
